headline: Public hearing on a $55,000 Canine Companions donation for a support/companion dog.
summary: Residents may speak about a $55,000 donation from Canine Companions for a support/companion dog. After public comments, the board will take the comments under advisement and receive and file any written documents.
items: Public hearing on a $55,000 donation from Canine Companions for a support/companion dog
Residents may speak for up to three minutes each
Motion to take comments under advisement and receive and file any written documents presented
plain_text:
AGENDA  
 
SPECIAL PUBLIC HEARING MEETING OF THE 
BOARD OF SCHOOL COMMITTEE  
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
 
Monday, October 26, 2026 6:30 p.m. 
Mayor and all School Board Members Aldermanic Chambers  
Student Member Julie Langlois (WHS) City Hall (3 rd Floor) 
 
1. Mayor Ruais calls the meeting to order. 
 
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
 
3. Mayor Ruais advises the purpose of the special public hearing meeting is to give the 
residents of Manchester the opportunity to address the board regarding a donation of 
$55,000 from Canine Companions for a support/companion dog.  All people wishing to 
speak will have up to three (3) minutes to do so, and any comments must be directed to 
the chair.  Any resident wishing to speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, 
clearly state their name and address when recognized and give their comments. 
 
 
4. Mayor Ruais advises that if there is no one else present wishing to speak, a motion is in 
order to take all comments under advisement and further to receive and file any written 
documentation presented. 
 
 
5. This being a special meeting of the board, no further business can be presented unless by 
2/3 majority and a motion is in order to adjourn. 
 
 
 
 
Statement of nondiscrimination: It is the policy of the Manchester Board of School Committee, in its actions, and those of its employees, that 
there shall be no discrimination on the basis of age, sex, race, color, marital status, physical or mental disability, religious creed, national origin 
or sexual orientation for employment in, or operation and administration of any program or activity in the Manchester School District.  The Title 
IX Coordinator is Dr. Kelly Espinola for staff and students. 
 
 
Per the Strategic Plan, our Mission objective is to provide a transformational learning experience and ensure that every MSD learner has 
high quality postsecondary options to attain a technical certificate, gainful employment, and/or a two-year or four-year degree.
